lang.title: Choose your language
common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.session_ended: Your session ended, so protection is paused. Sign in again to switch it back on.
phone.title: Your phone number
phone.help: We send a code to your Telegram to check it's you. Your number stays private.
phone.invalid: That doesn't look like a phone number. Check it and try again.
otp.title: Enter the 6-digit code
otp.format: The code is 6 numbers. Check it and try again.
otp.invalid: That code is not the newest one. Ask Telegram for a new code and type the latest one.
contacts.title: Emergency contacts
contacts.help: These people get your alerts. Every alert rings on their phone and keeps ringing until it is attended to.
contacts.invalid: Check the phone numbers. Each one must be valid and different.
pins.title: Your safety PIN
pins.mismatch: The two PINs do not match.
pins.must_differ: No past shares yet. They'll show up here.
perm.title: Make Sentri work when your phone is locked
perm.battery: Do not let the phone stop Sentri in the background
home.check_sub: Pick a time. If you're not safe by then, your contacts get a full alert.
home.check_until: Not safe by {time}? Your contacts get alerted.
triggers.title: Ways to call for help
triggers.power_note: Best effort: does not work on every phone brand.
sos.active: Alert is active. Your location is being shared.
sos.offline: No connection. Your alert is saved and goes out the moment you're online.
sos.responding: A contact is responding. Stay safe.
sos.locked: Too many tries. Try again later.
sos.contacts_busy: An earlier alert is still running. Your contacts are saved on this phone and will sync on their own - you can continue.
health.heart_none: No heart-rate source yet. Connect a health app or band to Health Connect.
health.heart_perm: Your photo stays on this phone. Only your name goes out with alerts.
health.heart_base: Usual resting rate: {n} bpm. Watching for any strange climb.
health.heart_watch: I'll tell you if it climbs strangely.
health.hr_alert_body: {n} bpm now. Rest a moment. Still high after resting? Use your emergency help.
health.water_sub: Gentle reminders at your pace. Pick one below.
health.water_body: A few sips now keeps you steady through the day.
health.water_ok: Set: every {n} this phone will chime. Keep Sentri off battery saving.
health.water_broken: This may not ring here. Pick the pace again, allow notifications, and remove Sentri from battery saving.
health.hosp_error: The map service is slow right now. Check your data, or tap Try again.
health.hosp_no_phone: No phone number saved on the map yet
health.heart_cam: Press a fingertip gently over the front camera, then tap below. No health app needed.
health.measure_nofeed: The camera did not send any picture. Make sure the screen is bright, you are not on a call, and try again.
health.measure_tip: Cover the front camera with a fingertip. Screen bright, hand still - the light reads your pulse.
health.measure_fail: That reading was not strong enough. Press the fingertip firmly over the lens, sit still, and try again.
health.measure_no_cam: No working camera, or the camera permission was not given. Check the camera permission and try again.
heart.trend_better: Trending better — your recent readings are lower.
heart.trend_steady: Trending steady — your readings are holding about the same.
heart.trend_worse: Trending worse — your recent readings are higher.
health.hosp_location: No location yet. Turn on GPS, step outside or near a window, and reopen this tab.
health.gym_none: No gym or stadium mapped nearby yet.
exercise.title: Exercise
exercise.sub: Walk, run or ride. Real steps, GPS distance, every session saved - records rewarded.
exercise.check_sub: A safety watch: if you're not back and safe in time, your contacts get a full alert.
exercise.perm_denied: Allow location and activity permissions, then start again.
exercise.discard_body: Nothing will be saved. The safety watch keeps running.
exercise.history_empty: Your sessions will show up here, each with its route.
award.shelf_hint: One badge per record. Keep going.
award.first_desc: Your first saved session. Everything starts here.
award.first_praise: Your first session! What a beautiful start!
award.km5_desc: Five kilometres walked, run or ridden in total.
award.km5_praise: Five kilometres done! You are really moving!
award.km10_desc: Ten kilometres in total. Your body is already thanking you.
award.km21_desc: Twenty-one kilometres in total - a half marathon on your legs.
award.km21_praise: A half marathon done! You are marvellous!
award.steps10k_desc: Ten thousand steps in one session.
award.record_km_desc: Farther in one go than you have ever gone before.
award.record_km_praise: A new distance record! Look at you go!
award.record_steps_desc: More steps in one session than ever before.
award.record_steps_praise: A new steps record! Your feet are on fire!
award.sessions5_desc: Five sessions completed. Exercise is part of your life now.
award.sessions5_praise: Five sessions! The habit is truly yours now!
map.unknown_place: Finding the name of this place...
map.route_failed: Couldn't plan this trip. Check your data, then tap Retry.
map.route_fix_gps: Still finding your spot. Turn GPS on, then tap Retry.
map.approx_hint: Your position is approximate. For an exact one: turn on GPS, set Sentri to Precise, go outside or near a window.
map.no_location: Turn on location to see where you are.
map.pick_hint: Tap and hold a spot on the map.
map.nearby_none: No named places within a short walk.
map.search_empty: Type a place, a street or a business.
map.search_no_results: No place found. Check the spelling or try a nearby town.
map.search_none_near: Not mapped near you yet. Try the next street or long-press the map.
map.reroute_say: Hold on — finding a fresh route from right here.
map.chat_1: Are you enjoying the ride? Keep it steady — I have the directions.
map.chat_2: What a day, right? You're doing great. Eyes on the road.
map.chat_3: Just checking in — you're driving nicely. I'm right here with you.
map.chat_4: Take a breath. We've got you covered, every turn of the way.
map.chat_5: Lovely driving. Whatever the day brought, you've got this.
map.chat_6: You're safe on this road — I'll whisper the turns, you enjoy the ride.
police.note: Official Nigeria Police lines for every state and the FCT. No answer? Call 112.
contacts.declined_note: A contact declined. Add someone else so at least two people can help.
contacts.load_failed: Could not load your contacts. Check your connection.
contacts.characters: Tap a contact to name them and pick one of 20 friendly characters. Saved on this phone only.
inbox.title: Messages
inbox.none: Nothing here yet. Alerts will show up here.
inbox.need_signin: Your session ended, so messages can't load right now. Sign in again to bring them back.
inbox.failed: Couldn't load messages. Pull down to try again.
inbox.invite_text: {n} added you as an emergency contact.
inbox.scam_note: Sentri never texts alerts or links. A text claiming to be Sentri is fake.
inbox.test_sent: Test sent to {n} of your contacts.
inbox.test_none: None of your contacts have Sentri yet.
inbox.test_wait: You can send another test in a few minutes.
share.title: Share location
share.help: Choose who follows you live. They're alerted when you start and stop.
share.limit_note: Sharing ends on its own when time is up. It can't be left on.
share.live_note: Your contacts were alerted. They'll be alerted again when you stop.
share.invite_text: I added you as my emergency contact on Sentri. Install it so I can alert you in danger.
share.none_reachable: None of those people have Sentri yet.
share.stop_pending: Stopping. This finishes as soon as you're back online.
contacts.app_only: Alerts reach contacts inside the app. Invite anyone without Sentri.
police.approx: Closest command by distance - official NPF lines. No answer? Call 112.
police.cant_dial: Couldn't open the phone app. Dial the number by hand.
police.none_found: No police numbers found for this area.
police.waiting: Waiting for a location fix. You can still call 112.
otp.send_failed: We couldn't send the code. Check the number and try again in a moment.
otp.too_many: Too many codes requested. Try again in an hour.
otp.test_code: Test mode: your code is {code}. Tap to fill it in.
otp.telegram_sent: Get your code for {phone} on Telegram.
otp.telegram_hint: In Telegram: tap Start, then Share my number. Your code lands in that chat - type it here.
sos.police_note: Need the police? Call 112 or the nearest line below.

award.sessions25_desc: Twenty-five sessions completed. Dedication made visible.

award.steps5k_desc: Five thousand steps in one session.

award.minutes30_desc: Thirty minutes of movement in one session.
award.sessions50_desc: Fifty sessions completed. Movement is who you are.
award.streak3_praise: Three sessions in one week! On fire!
award.first_run_desc: Your first run on record. Off the mark.
